item.title: Welcome Ji!
item.description:
COSINE LAB is excited to announce that Ji has officially joined us as our very first Cosiner.

As the inaugural member of the team, Ji will be instrumental in launching our research initiatives and shaping the lab’s collaborative culture. We are thrilled to have his talent and energy on board as we begin this journey.

Welcome to the lab, Ji!
